title: Briefing for 2026-10-19
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-19: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: India’s Finance Minister blames easy exits and excess liquidity for equity market's underperformance. U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all. Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done. U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting. Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge.
global: Macron calls for 'calm and order' after riots across France. Major fire at Canada military base leaves four dead, dozens injured. Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going. Inside the shadowy world of anti-Putin sabotage from within Russia. Inside Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US. EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says.
philippines: Ombudsman dismisses Urdaneta mayor, 7 others for defying suspension order. 5 Questions with NBA insider Brian Windhorst. [Inside the Newsroom] China’s envoy: Sounds like a threat, walks like a threat. Zelenskyy criticizes Trump’s waiver of sanctions on Russia as ‘wrong’.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
